name: Cychlorphine
summary: Cychlorphine is a synthetic opioid chemical compound sold as a designer drug which has been linked to hospitalizations and fatal overdoses in the United States, Europe and Canada. It is similar in chemical structure to known opioid agonists such as brorphine and spirochlorphine. It is suggested to be more potent than fentanyl. It is not a structural analog of morphine, despite the similar name.

pharmacology.text: It is similar in chemical structure to known opioid agonists such as brorphine and spirochlorphine.

uses.text: Cychlorphine is a synthetic opioid chemical compound sold as a designer drug which has been linked to hospitalizations and fatal overdoses in the United States, Europe and Canada. In July 2026 the Danish health authority recommended using Naloxone as an immediate treatment.

summaryZh: 環氯啡（英語：Cychlorphine），又稱N-Propionitrile chlorphine或Cyanoethyl chlorphine，是一種強效合成阿片類藥物，屬於哌啶基苯並咪唑酮類化合物及Orphine類阿片類藥物。

sideEffects.en: It causes typical opioid effects such as drowsiness, nausea and dependence. It has been linked to hospital admissions and fatal overdoses, as it can slow or stop breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、噁心與依賴等典型鴉片類作用。由於它可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止，已與住院及致命過量案例有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、恶心与依赖等典型鸦片类作用。由于它可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止，已与住院及致命过量案例有关。

fact.en: It belongs to the orphine opioids, a newer designer group named after brorphine, which first appeared on the drug market around 2019.
fact.zh: 它屬於「orphine」類鴉片，這是一個較新的設計師藥物家族，以約在 2019 年首次出現在毒品市場的 brorphine 命名。
fact.zhHans: 它属于「orphine」类鸦片，这是一个较新的设计师药物家族，以约在 2019 年首次出现在毒品市场的 brorphine 命名。
